items.headline: IRGC claims another tanker mine blast south of Hormuz on Monday
items.blurb: Early Monday Iran's IRGC said a 'violating' oil tanker exploded after hitting a mine south of the Strait, with GPS/navigation off. Weekend claims of two mine-struck tankers still lack independent confirmation; the US says the strait remains open for commercial shipping.
items.why_matters: Oil risk is still live into the week open — a fresh spike would feed inflation and hike fears just as BTC tests the upper half of its $80–86k range.

items.headline: Oil slips on Monday open after Friday's spike; WTI still elevated WoW
items.blurb: Reuters: Brent and WTI eased in early Asian trade after a Trump sanction waiver raised the chance of more Russian fuel supply. Our Yahoo print shows WTI near $97.6 on the Monday hist bar, still up about 3.6% over five sessions after last week's surge toward $100+.
items.why_matters: Weekend Hormuz headlines did not force a fresh oil breakout on the open — inflation pressure is still high, but the immediate Monday spike risk cooled a notch.

items.headline: Monday ETF print still pending; last week ended −$228M BTC outflows
items.blurb: Farside still ends at Fri 16 Oct (−$82.4M that day). Full week Oct 12–16: bitcoin ETFs about −$228M vs about −$679M the week before; ether ETFs also lighter outflows. Monday's US session print lands after the close.
items.why_matters: Week-open flows are the next tell after two outflow weeks — whether selling keeps slowing or re-accelerates into the Oct 27–28 FOMC.

items.headline: FedWatch hike odds jump into the Oct 27–28 FOMC (Estimated)
items.blurb: GMT Eight, citing CME FedWatch on Monday, put a ~65% chance on a 25bp October hike vs ~35% hold — a sharp re-pricing from the ~18% hike odds carried from the 10-16 CNBC/CME read. CME's own page remains JS-only and was not parsed directly.
items.why_matters: Higher near-term hike odds tighten the macro backdrop for risk assets into next week's FOMC; treat as Estimated until a major desk confirms.

items.headline: BTC opens the week near $82.4k; WoW flips positive as prior losses roll off
items.blurb: Coinbase/Yahoo show BTC around $82.4k early Monday — about +0.8% WoW and +1.4% MoM as last week's mid-week flush drops out of the seven-day window. Dominance near 60%. Nasdaq still −4.5% over five sessions from Friday's close.
items.why_matters: A calmer week-open tape after Hormuz weekend risk, but AI/tech damage and rebuilding leverage mean $80k and ~$84k still frame the range.
